# ============================================================
#             PREDICTIONS BY YEAR - CLASS DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================
def plot_time_series_predictions(y_pred, years, title="Model Predictions by Year", figsize=(14, 7)):
    """
    Plot a line graph showing count of each class label per year.
    
    Parameters:
        y_pred: predicted labels
        years: array of years corresponding to each prediction
        title: plot title
        figsize: figure size for the plot
    """
    # Create DataFrame for grouping
    pred_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'Year': years,
        'Prediction': y_pred
    })
    
    # Count predictions for each class by year
    class0_by_year = pred_df[pred_df['Prediction'] == 0].groupby('Year').size()
    class1_by_year = pred_df[pred_df['Prediction'] == 1].groupby('Year').size()
    class2_by_year = pred_df[pred_df['Prediction'] == 2].groupby('Year').size()
    class3_by_year = pred_df[pred_df['Prediction'] == 3].groupby('Year').size()
    
    # Get all unique years and reindex
    all_years = sorted(pred_df['Year'].unique())
    class0_by_year = class0_by_year.reindex(all_years, fill_value=0)
    class1_by_year = class1_by_year.reindex(all_years, fill_value=0)
    class2_by_year = class2_by_year.reindex(all_years, fill_value=0)
    class3_by_year = class3_by_year.reindex(all_years, fill_value=0)
    
    # Create plot
    plt.figure(figsize=figsize)
    plt.plot(all_years, class0_by_year.values, color='green', linewidth=2.5, marker='o', 
             label='Class 0 (No Risk)', markersize=5)
    plt.plot(all_years, class1_by_year.values, color='gold', linewidth=2.5, marker='s', 
             label='Class 1 (Moderate)', markersize=5)
    plt.plot(all_years, class2_by_year.values, color='orange', linewidth=2.5, marker='^', 
             label='Class 2 (High)', markersize=5)
    plt.plot(all_years, class3_by_year.values, color='red', linewidth=2.5, marker='D', 
             label='Class 3 (Recession)', markersize=5)
    
    plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
    plt.ylabel('Number of Countries', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
    plt.title(title, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    plt.legend(fontsize=11, loc='best')
    plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
